Job Description

Veterans and Military Spouses belong at Oracle

This is a place where your military experience and talent will help you thrive. Our culture of inclusion values the skills that veterans bring to our workforce and empowers you to use them to transform the world for the better. Get a head start on your civilian career today.

About the Oracle Veteran Internship Program (OVIP):

Oracle is proud to sponsor an internship and integration program that exposes transitioning military veterans and active-duty Military Spouses new to the corporate culture, provides hands-on job-skill training and experience, and offers enhanced professional and personal development. At Oracle, we are committed to the development and professional growth of our veterans and military spouses. Our paid internship program is specifically designed to aid military veterans, transitioning servicemembers and active-duty military spouses new to the corporate sector in their transition to a career in the private or public sector.

Veterans and Military Spouses accepted into our program will work closely with corporate leadership, military veteran coaches and HR professionals to help prepare for a successful transition. Interns will engage in on-the-job training and professional development in fields such as information technology, technical/systems consulting, technical support, facilities, finance, human resources, logistics, marketing, sales or developmental training in sales or for customer support (as available).

US Veteran transitioning from active service or Military Spouse new to corporate experience preferred

About the Company:

For more than four decades, Oracle has delivered innovations that have helped build entire industries. We remain the gold standard as the world’s first autonomous database and industry’s broadest and deepest suite of AI-powered cloud applications. The following facts and figures highlight some of the many ways we continue to deliver innovations for our customers, partners, and communities. With annual revenue of US$57 billion in FY2025, Oracle is the world’s largest EHR implementation, serving more than 9.5 million beneficiaries spanning the United States, Europe, and the Asia Pacific region; has 5 million registered members of Oracle’s customer and developer communities; and 469 independent user communities in 97 countries representing more than 1 million members.

Additional Information:

Hourly wage is $30 per hour. This is a 40 hour per week position

Responsibilities

We are seeking a highly motivated AI Agent Intern to join Oracle’s Supply Chain Applications (SCM) Solution Engineering organization. This intern will work at the intersection of Artificial Intelligence, Logistics Execution, and Oracle Fusion SCM Applications, helping design, prototype, and demonstrate next-generation AI Agents for Supply Chain.

You will support the development of AI-driven capabilities across Oracle Transportation Management (OTM), Global Trade Management (GTM), Warehouse Management (WMS), Inventory, and SCM Analytics. You’ll collaborate with senior Solution Engineers, product experts, and Oracle’s AI innovation teams to build proof-of-concepts, demo assets, and internal accelerators that showcase the “Autonomous, Agentic Supply Chain of the Future.”

This role is ideal for someone who is passionate about AI, optimization, and modern logistics—and wants hands-on experience building intelligent supply chain solutions used by the world’s largest organizations.

Key Responsibilities

AI Agent Development & Prototyping



-  Assist in designing and building AI Agents using Oracle AI Services, OCI Generative AI, and Fusion SCM data. 
-  Prototype agent workflows for logistics scenarios (e.g., shipment risk detection, exception resolution, trade compliance, warehouse task optimization). 
-  Support development of RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) pipelines using Oracle’s Agent Studio and Vector Store. 
-  Conduct data exploration and create sample datasets for agent testing. 


Solution Engineering & Demo Support



-  Build and maintain demo assets for OTM, GTM, WMS, Inventory, and SCM Analytics. 
-  Support interactive scenarios illustrating AI-driven logistics (e.g., temperature excursions, carrier delays, customs risks, inbound ETA disruptions). 
-  Help create reference architectures, diagrams, and demo scripts. 


Research & Analysis



-  Evaluate logistics AI use cases (forecasting, resilience, risk management, optimization). 
-  Conduct analysis across leading AI supply chain platforms. 
-  Document best practices for designing AI Agents in Oracle SCM. 


Cross-Functional Collaboration



-  Work with senior SCM SEs across Logistics, Order Management, Inventory, and Manufacturing. 
-  Engage with Oracle AI Champions, Applied Technologists, and Product Strategy. 
-  Participate in team enablement sessions, conferences/trade shows, and industry-focused prototype work. 


Qualifications

Required



-  Pursuing a degree in Supply Chain, Computer Science, Industrial Engineering, Data Science, Operations Research, or related field. 
-  Strong interest in modern logistics (transportation, warehousing, global trade, inventory). 
-  Foundational understanding of AI concepts—LLMs, RAG, embeddings, agents, and automation. 
-  Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving skills. 
-  Excellent written and verbal communication skills. 


Preferred



-  Knowledge of Oracle Supply Chain Cloud or similar platforms (SAP, Manhattan, Blue Yonder, etc.). 
-  Familiarity with Python, SQL, APIs, or basic scripting. 
-  Experience with analytics tools. 
-  Coursework or experience in machine learning, forecasting, optimization, or operations research. 
-  Understanding of logistics concepts: network design, last mile, freight planning, carrier performance, compliance, and inventory accuracy. 


What You’ll Gain



-  Hands-on experience with Oracle’s newest AI Agent technologies. 
-  Exposure to major supply chain transformation projects (e.g., retail, manufacturing, consumer goods, defense). 
-  Training on Oracle Transportation Management (OTM), Global Trade Management (GTM), Warehouse Management (WMS), Inventory, and SCM Analytics. 
-  Mentorship from senior members of Oracle’s Logistics & SCM Solution Engineering team. 
-  Opportunity to build portfolio-ready AI agent prototypes. 
-  Experience presenting to leaders, product teams, and cross-functional stakeholders. 


Why Oracle SCM Solution Engineering?

You will join a team on the front lines of transforming how global supply chains operate. Oracle SCM is at the center of enabling resilient, autonomous, AI-powered logistics across the world. As an intern, you will directly contribute to the next generation of intelligent supply chain capabilities that Oracle brings to market.

We run a mixture of cloud-based and on-prem systems and have a user base spanning from highly technically proficient engineers to non-technical scientists and doctors; but all of them need solid systems, rugged networking, and bullet-proof software to do their jobs.  Please note that you are limited to one application during the recruitment period as we ask you to think ahead of what office and service line you are most interested in. This position is for a 4-month intern / co-op term. 

 Overview   
  
 At KPMG in Canada, our people bring their unique perspectives to Canada’s most important challenges. Here, you can develop your skills alongside experienced professionals, contribute to meaningful work, and build a foundation for your career within one of Canada’s leading professional services firms .   
  
 KPMG in Canada is growing a team of AI Builders who work with our business teams to explore how AI can improve the way we work. As an AI Builder Intern/Co-op, you will work alongside experienced builders, engineers, and business professionals to turn emerging AI capabilities into prototypes for real business challenges .  You will contribute your own ideas, test your work with users, and share it with teams across the firm, gaining firsthand experience in how a major organization puts AI into practice.   
 
 What you will do 

• Build and test AI agents, automations, demos, and other prototypes using KPMG’s approved tools, with guidance from experienced team members.   
• Work with internal teams to understand their workflows, identify problems, and explore where AI could help.   
• Help define what a prototype should do, test whether it works as intended, and improve it based on feedback.   
• Assist with evaluations, documentation, and integrations with approved tools and data sources.   
• Explore how Model Context Protocol (MCP) connects AI tools to systems and data, and help test MCP-based workflows where appropriate .   
• Create reusable components, build notes, and demonstrations that help other teams learn from your work.   
• Participate in AI Lab activities and share your findings with the broader builder community.   
• Learn how security, privacy, governance, and human oversight shape AI solutions in a regulated enterprise.    
  
 Your work will focus primarily on experimentation and prototyping. You may also support more mature solutions alongside engineering and internal transformation teams.   
 
 What you bring to the role 

 We welcome students from engineering, computer science, business, design, data science, and related fields, as well as those who have developed technical skills through independent projects.   
 
• You are enrolled in a post-secondary program and are eligible for an internship or co-op work term.   
• You have built something you can discuss, whether through a personal project, a hackathon, previous employment, volunteer work, or coursework. It could be an app, automation, workflow, AI experiment, or other working prototype.   
• You have a working understanding of AI agents, reusable skills, and Model Context Protocol (MCP).   
• You enjoy learning new tools and can explain how you approached a problem, tested an idea, and responded to what you learned.   
• You are interested in how people work and how technology can improve a real process.   
• You communicate clearly, collaborate well, and are comfortable asking questions when a problem is unclear.   
• You are curious about agentic AI and thoughtful about its limitations, risks, and appropriate use .    
 Experience building with AI development tools, APIs, low-code platforms, or enterprise systems is an asset, but you do not need experience with all of them.   
  
 Where and how you’ll work   
  
 You will be based in KPMG’s AI Lab in Toronto. This is a hybrid role with a strong in-person component . You will be expected to work from the Toronto office three to five days per week , depending on lab activities, team needs, and your projects.   
 You will work with internal teams across the firm, gaining exposure to business challenges, professional disciplines, and enterprise AI applications that extend beyond the classroom.   
  
 What’s in it for you   

• Hands-on experience building and testing AI prototypes for real internal use cases.   
• Direct mentorship from experienced builders, engineers, and business professionals, helping you develop both technical depth and professional judgment.   
• Exposure to complex enterprise workflows and the practical considerations involved in adopting AI responsibly.   
• Opportunities to demonstrate your work, learn from feedback, and contribute reusable ideas and components.   
• Access to approved AI models, frameworks, and tools through KPMG’s secure AI Lab environment.    
  
 How to apply   
  
 Please submit :   
 
• Your resume.   
• One project you’ve built and are proud of (required, please include on your cover letter). Briefly describe what you built, your contribution, and what you learned. The project does not need to use AI.   
• Your GitHub profile ( required, please include on either resume or cover letter) 
• A link to the project (optional). This could be a demo, video, or write-up.  
 We’re interested in how you approach a problem and bring an idea to life. If your project is private or cannot be shared, you can still describe it in your application.   
  
 What does the recruitment process look like?   
  
 Step 1: Apply. Submit the materials listed above.   
 Step 2: Interview and practical discussion. Shortlisted candidates may be invited to discuss their project or complete a scoped exercise that shows how they approach a problem. Instructions and expectations will be shared in advance.   
 Step 3: Hiring decision. Final candidates will be assessed on their skills, potential, collaboration, and approach to responsible AI use.   

 KPMG Ontario Region Pay Range Information 
The expected base salary range for this position is $50,000 to $63,000 and may be eligible for bonus awards. The determination of an applicant’s base salary within this range is based on the individual’s location, skills & competencies, and unique qualifications. In addition, KPMG offers a comprehensive and competitive Total Rewards program. 
 
 Our Values, The KPMG Way 

 Integrity , we do what is right |  Excellence , we never stop learning and improving |  Courage , we think and act boldly | Together , we respect each other and draw strength from our differences |  For Better , we do what matters 
  
 KPMG in Canada is a proud equal opportunities employer and we are committed to creating a respectful, inclusive and barrier-free workplace that allows all of our people to reach their full potential. A diverse workforce is key to our success and we believe in bringing your whole self to work. We welcome all qualified candidates to apply and hope you will choose KPMG in Canada as your employer of choice. 
  
 Adjustments and accommodations throughout the recruitment process 
  
 At KPMG, we are committed to fostering an inclusive recruitment process where all candidates can be themselves and excel. We aim to provide a positive experience and are prepared to offer adjustments or accommodations to help you perform at your best. Adjustments (informal requests), such as extra preparation time or the option for micro breaks during interviews, and accommodations (formal requests), such as accessible communication supports or technology aids, are tailored to individual needs and role requirements. You will have an opportunity to request an adjustment or accommodation at any point throughout the recruitment process. If you require support, please contact KPMG’s Employee Relations Service team by calling 1-888-466-4778. 
  
 AI Usage 
  
 We embrace the use of artificial intelligence (AI) to enhance the candidate experience and streamline our recruitment processes. AI tools may help with organizing applications or surfacing relevant qualifications. However, no hiring decisions are made using AI. Every hiring decision is made by our hiring managers and recruitment professionals, who are equipped with training that empowers them to use these tools responsibly. AI technologies used in our recruitment process undergo detailed risk assessments, including security and privacy requirements, that align with KPMG’s Trusted AI framework. 
  
 We believe technology should empower human judgment, not replace it. It’s one of the many ways we’re delivering on our vision of being a technology-first, people-driven firm.

Their dedicated efforts ensure that we deliver cutting-edge entertainment experiences that captivate and inspire players and fans globally. 

 We’re looking for  2 x   AI/ML Software Engineer Co-op Masters students  to join our team. You will be responsible for assisting with our experimental Research and Development (R&D) work within EA’s Sports Quality Verification Engineering organization. Primarily, this work will focus on the Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligent domain and will be the foundation for our next generation of tools and solutions for driving effectiveness and efficiencies in our QV process. The successful candidates will play a pivotal role in this transformation. 

 We encourage candidates from all backgrounds  who meet the core requirements   to apply, even if you do not meet every qualification.  

 Primary Responsibilities 
 
• Gathering use-case requirements from our partner teams and organizations. 
 
• Providing research into possible solutions, running experiments, providing proofs of concept, demonstrating your results, and providing recommendations. 
 
• Providing improvements to existing solution implementations. 
 
• Updating existing Machine Learning models and enhancing data sets. 
 
• Helping to productize AI/ML solutions and roll them out to our partners. 
 
• Providing documentation and gathering feedback from our partners. 

 Requirements: 
 
• You must be legally authorized to work in Canada for the entire internship -  visa sponsorship is not available.

• Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, C++, or C# for software and model development. 
 
• Familiarity with updating existing machine learning models, fine-tuning, and enhancing datasets for performance. 
 
• Demonstrated proficiency in agentic workflows and the optimization of Large Language Model (LLM) prompts. 
 
• Understanding of software development life cycles (SDLC), engineering best practices, and collaborative version control tools like Git. 
 
• Strong problem-solving and analytical skills with the ability to research, experiment, and prototype solutions for R&D challenges. 
 
• Basic knowledge or experience in gathering use-case requirements and translating them into technical specifications.

• Proactive mindset with a demonstrated ability to independently complete tasks, run experiments, and escalate technical issues appropriately.
